Container.Name: neko-librewolf
Container.Overview:
neko (m1k1o, v3) virtual browser with LibreWolf instead of Firefox. Several people can watch and take turns controlling one browser over WebRTC. uBlock Origin, Dark Reader and FoxMCP (MCP browser control for AI agents) are preinstalled. Optional RTMP broadcast of the desktop.
Set both passwords and NEKO_WEBRTC_NAT1TO1 (the IP your viewers use to reach this server; the Unraid LAN IP for LAN-only use). The WebRTC port must be the same inside and outside and reachable by viewers (UDP, TCP as fallback). Optional: add --cap-add=SYS_ADMIN to Extra Parameters for an extra LibreWolf sandbox layer (trade-off in the README). Full documentation: https://github.com/Bluscream/neko-librewolf-docker/blob/master/apps/librewolf/README.md
Container.Requires: Choose a WebRTC port that is free on the host and forward it (UDP + TCP) on your router if viewers come from the internet.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: neko web interface (HTTP). Put a reverse proxy with TLS in front of it for access from outside the LAN.

Config.Name: WebRTC (UDP)
Config.Description: WebRTC media. Host port MUST equal NEKO_WEBRTC_UDPMUX.

Config.Name: WebRTC (TCP fallback)
Config.Description: WebRTC over TCP for networks that block UDP. Host port MUST equal NEKO_WEBRTC_TCPMUX.

Config.Name: FoxMCP (MCP over HTTP)
Config.Description: Optional. MCP endpoint for AI agents to control the browser (http://host:port/mcp). Anyone who reaches it controls the browser: leave empty, or bind to a trusted address only.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for admins (may take control, kick, change settings).

Config.Name: Public IP (NAT1TO1)
Config.Description: IP that viewers connect to for WebRTC: the server's LAN IP for LAN use, your public IP for internet use. Empty = auto-detect the public IP at start.

Config.Name: WebRTC TCP mux port
Config.Description: Must match the WebRTC (TCP fallback) port.

Config.Name: ICE servers (JSON)
Config.Description: Optional STUN/TURN servers for viewers, JSON list, e.g. [{"urls":["turn:turn.example.com:3478"],"username":"u","credential":"p"}].

Config.Name: Broadcast URL
Config.Description: Optional RTMP target for streaming the desktop, e.g. rtmp://restreamer:1935/live/key. Start/stop it in the admin menu or via the API.

Config.Name: Broadcast autostart
Config.Description: Start the broadcast when neko starts (neko default: true).

Config.Name: Broadcast pipeline
Config.Description: Optional custom GStreamer pipeline (see README: H.264 4:2:0 for HLS players, 1 s keyframes for low latency).

Config.Name: Profile
Config.Description: LibreWolf profile (logins, cookies, extensions). Owned by uid 1000.
